relations: The orange egg rests on the pale floor beneath the transparent plastic slide.
If rolled upward along the slide, the egg moves against the incline before reversing.
When slowed or released near the top, the egg rolls downward on the plastic surface.
Rolling down the slide, the egg descends toward the bottom and comes to rest there.
caption: A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
